title: GeneratedRunDraft
description: Lowered strict-output schema for natural-language configuration proposals. This is not RunConfig and cannot be executed directly. Numeric bounds and cross-field rules are described in prose; the canonical RunConfig schema remains the execution gate.

name.description: Optional analyst-facing run name. Use null to let the app generate one.

application.description: A bundled benchmark or manual logical-count input. Uploaded files are selected locally by the analyst and cannot be proposed here.

numQubits.description: Logical qubit count. Must be at least 1.

tCount.description: T count. Must be a non-negative whole number.

rotationCount.description: Rotation count. Must be a non-negative whole number.

rotationDepth.description: Rotation depth. Must be non-negative and no greater than rotationCount.

cczCount.description: CCZ count. Must be a non-negative whole number.

ccixCount.description: CCiX count. Must be a non-negative whole number.

measurementCount.description: Measurement count. Must be a non-negative whole number.

architecture.description: Physical architecture proposal. Architecture-specific limits remain enforced by canonical validation.

errorRate.description: Physical error rate. Must be greater than 0 and less than 0.01; default 0.0001.

gateTime.description: Single-qubit gate time in ns. Required whole number greater than 0.

measurementTime.description: Measurement time in ns. Required whole number greater than 0.

twoQubitGateTime.description: Optional two-qubit gate time in ns. Use null to let qdk derive it; otherwise use a whole number greater than 0.

operationTime.description: Operation time in ns. Must be a whole number greater than 0; default 1000.

tErrorRate.description: Optional T error rate. Use null to let qdk derive it; otherwise greater than 0 and at most 0.05.

targetYear.description: Optional non-negative target year. Use null to omit it. This value is recorded but currently inert.

rydbergTime.description: Rydberg time in ns. Whole number greater than 0; default 500.

rydbergError.description: Rydberg error. At least 0 and less than 0.01; default 0.001.

singleQubitTime.description: Single-qubit time in ns. Whole number greater than 0; default 1000.

singleQubitError.description: Single-qubit error. At least 0 and less than 0.01; default 0.0001.

measurementTime.description: Measurement time in ns. Whole number greater than 0; default 10000.

measurementError.description: Measurement error. At least 0 and less than 0.01; default 0.0001.

handoffTime.description: Handoff time in ns. Non-negative whole number; default 0.

atomSpacing.description: Atom spacing in micrometers. Greater than 0; default 3.0.

dataQubitSpacing.description: Optional data-qubit spacing in micrometers. Use null to omit it; otherwise greater than 0.

maxVelocity.description: Maximum atom velocity in m/s. Greater than 0; default 0.25.

maxAcceleration.description: Maximum atom acceleration in m/s squared. Greater than 0; default 5000.

surfaceCodeOneQubitTimeFactor.description: Surface-code single-qubit time factor. Whole number at least 1; default 1.

surfaceCodeTwoQubitTimeFactor.description: Surface-code two-qubit time factor. Whole number at least 1; default 1.

targetYear.description: Optional non-negative target year. Use null to omit it. This value is recorded but currently inert.

magicStateFactories.description: Non-empty unique factory set. round_based is always allowed; litinski19 and gsj24 have architecture/error-rate coupling rules checked by the app.

secondaryFactories.description: Secondary factory set. Use an empty array for none. magic_up_to_clifford is incompatible with Majorana; gsj24_ccx tracks CCX magic-state synthesis.

memoryOptimization.description: Memory optimization selection. Use none unless the requested pipeline supports a yoked code.

parameters.description: Parameters for the benchmark named in application.benchmarkId. Choose the variant that matches it; use the 'none' variant for manual logical counts or when proposing no parameters. Modelled as one variant per benchmark rather than twelve nullable fields because the API caps a structured-output schema at 16 union-typed parameters and the flat shape spent twelve of them.

bitSize.description: Shor bit size, whole number from 2 through 8192.

generator.description: Factoring generator, whole number from 2 through 65535.
Factoring generator, whole number from 2 through 65535.

latticeN1.description: Ising-model first lattice dimension, whole number from 1 through 1000.

latticeN2.description: Ising-model second lattice dimension, whole number from 1 through 1000.

totalTime.description: Ising-model total time, greater than 0 and at most 1e6.

trotterStep.description: Ising-model Trotter step, at least 1e-6 and no greater than totalTime.

couplingJ.description: Ising-model coupling J, any finite real number.

fieldG.description: Ising-model field g, any finite real number.

searchQubits.description: Grover search-qubit count, whole number from 1 through 63.

precision.description: Phase-estimation precision, whole number from 1 through 63.

registerSize.description: Phase-estimation register size, whole number from 1 through 1000.

anyOf.description: No benchmark parameters are being proposed.

traceTransform.description: Ordered Dynamic Memory Compute, PSSPC, Lattice Surgery, Unmemory pipeline proposal.

tStatesPerRotation.description: PSSPC T count per arbitrary rotation, whole number from 5 through 20; default 20.

ccxMagicStates.description: Whether PSSPC synthesizes CCX from magic states; default false.

slowDownFactor.description: Fixed Lattice Surgery slowdown factor. Always 1.

dynamicMemoryCompute.description: Use null when stage 0 is off; otherwise provide both stage settings.

computeCapacityPercentage.description: Compute-capacity fraction, greater than 0 and at most 1; qdk default 0.5.

unmemory.description: Whether stage 3 is enabled. It is currently inert on this pipeline; default false.

maxError.description: Total fault-tolerant execution error cap, greater than 0 and at most 1; default 1.
